description: List direct children of a backbone taxon — genera within a family, species within a genus, subspecies within a species. Paginated. Use gbif_match_species to get the taxonKey first, then iterate with offset for large groups.

limit.description: Number of children to return (default 20, max 1000).

taxonKey.description: GBIF backbone taxon key from gbif_match_species or another taxonomy tool.

name: gbif_get_species_children

cap.description: Limit applied when the result was truncated. Re-call with offset to page on.

items.description: A direct child taxon with key, name, rank, and status.

numDescendants.description: Count of child taxa under this node.

endOfRecords.description: True when there are no more results after this page.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The taxonKey does not exist in the GBIF backbone. `invalid_filter`: GBIF rejected the taxonKey as unparseable — a fraction, or a value outside the 32-bit signed integer range. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Agent guidance — a no-children note for a valid taxon, or a pagination note when the page was capped. Absent on a complete single page.

shown.description: Children returned in this page when the result was truncated.

truncated.description: True when more children exist beyond this page. Absent on the final page.

title: Get Species Children
